summary: ChatGPT Chat/Pro owns reasoning, proposals, methodology, prioritization, spending design, and consequential tradeoffs.
Codex/Work is execution-only for bounded tasks Chat cannot execute.
Paid API model inference is canceled while included Extra High ChatGPT capacity is available.
Routine internal supervisor routing is automatic; Joel is never asked to relay a prompt or say send it.

rootCause: The prior zero-dollar execution ceiling blocked calls but did not make Codex-authored spending design itself invalid.
The reasoning/execution boundary existed as policy but lacked a task-local executable admission gate before proposals and browser routing.
Reasoning-source identity was not required before claiming that a named ChatGPT chat had already made a proposal.
A generic browser representational-communication rule overrode a more specific standing authorization for internal supervisor routing.
Subtask completion and routing friction were allowed to stop the parent outcome instead of forcing the next eligible step.
